```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet")
```

```{r}
set.seed(9)
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect() |>
  slice_sample(n = 10)
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarise(mean_mcap = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), days = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(mean_mcap)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

prices <- open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect()

metadata <- open_dataset("data/coin_metadata.parquet") |>
  collect()

categories <- open_dataset("data/categories.parquet") |>
  collect()

crypto <- prices |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(categories |> select(-description), by = "category_id") |>
  mutate(date = as_date(date_raw))
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date)
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  mutate(launch = as_date(parse_date_time(launch_date, orders = c("mdy", "ymd")))) |>
  arrange(launch) |>
  select(coin_id, launch_date, launch)
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Bitcoin Daily Price",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Price (USD)"
  )
```



```{r}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 7

category_shares <- crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(mcap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

category_order <- category_shares |>
  group_by(category_name) |>
  summarise(typical_mcap = median(mcap, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(typical_mcap)) |>
  pull(category_name)

category_shares <- category_shares |>
  mutate(category_name = factor(category_name,
                                levels = category_order))

ggplot(category_shares,
       aes(x = date, y = mcap, fill = category_name)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-05-07"),
    xmax = as.Date("2022-05-12"),
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey40", alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-11-08"),
    xmax = as.Date("2022-11-11"),
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey40", alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date(c("2022-05-09", "2022-11-09")),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", direction = -1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "How Has the Crypto Market Changed Over Time?",
    subtitle = "Daily share of total market capitalization by cryptocurrency category",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of Total Market Cap",
    fill = "Cryptocurrency Category",
    caption = paste(
      "Source: Crypto Markets dataset.",
      "Shaded periods: Luna/UST crash (May 7–12, 2022)",
      "and FTX collapse (Nov 8–11, 2022)."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```
